messages:
Priya Nair: Heads-up — I'm opening a docs PR to update the AuroraX‑13b model card. Changes are: adjust supported sequence limits, clarify CPU fallback behavior (remove implicit f16 fallbacks), add a short migration guide for SDK v1 -> v3 snippets, and refresh benchmark numbers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321

Sam Wei: thanks. can you paste the exact new limits here so I can update the catalog matrix and the per-region availability card?

Priya Nair: new limits: max_context_tokens = 12288, recommended_batch_size = 4 for p4d, fallback_batch_size_cpu = 1 (no f16 kernel fallback on CPU). added note: long‑context generation may hit memory cliffs above 8k so use kv caching.

Jamie Ortiz: Benchmark summary I ran on p4d: baseline fp16 unquantized = ~480 tok/s @ seq=512, quantized int8 (w/ AOT kernels) = ~360 tok/s, 8k context throughput drops ~35%. I'll paste a short table in the PR.

Luis Gomez: on the compatibility side: v1 quant profiles that used CPU f16 fallback need explicit replacement with the new cpu_int8 profile or note to pin to dedicated. Will add a compatibility paragraph. Also suggest adding an automatic fallback example that prefers cheaper quantized variant: 

Eve Park: I'll take the SDK snippets. we should replace old sync v1 example with streaming-friendly v3 snippet and add a migration diff block. Proposed snippet: 
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
resp = client.chat.create(model="aurorax-13b", messages=[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the README"}], stream=False)
print(resp.output_text)
```

Sam Wei: looks good. small ask: include a short note for customers using 'AuroraX-13b-small' variant — call out that sequence limits are 1/2 of the main model and link to the variant table. Also add a one‑liner about latency SLOs per region.

Priya Nair: good call. I'll add a 'Variant limits' section with the half‑size numbers and link to the catalog variant page.

Jamie Ortiz: also adding two benchmark plots (seq=512 and seq=8192) and a short methodology note: 16k token warmup, 5 runs median, avg batch size 2. cc @Luis for config reproducibility.

Luis Gomez: copying config here: 
```yaml
model: aurorax-13b
hardware: p4d
precision: fp16
batch_size: 2
sequence: [512,8192]
runs: 5
metrics: throughput,latency,mem
```

Priya Nair: quick doc coordination Q — can someone grep for other SDK v1 snippets referencing AuroraX and open a follow-up fix PR? I only changed the main card.

Eve Park: I can run a repo grep and file follow-ups. planning to batch snippets changes in one PR per top‑level folder.

docs-bot: CI: docs-lint passed for PR 4321 — 3 warnings (long lines). Preview build: https://deploy-preview.redwood-docs/pull/4321

Sam Wei: when PR is merged, I'll queue a catalog patch to sync the limits table and update the 'Supported models' index. can we add a changelog line for the deprecation of CPU f16 fallback?

Priya Nair: yes — short changelog blurb under 'Model behavior changes' + a note in the migration guide. thanks everyone — I'll push the followups this afternoon and tag reviewers on the PR. :pray:

Eve Park: ping me when followups are open, I'll review snippets and the migration diff.

Jamie Ortiz: lgtm from bench side. leaving for the afternoon but reachable if anything breaks.

Luis Gomez: will add compatibility/rollback steps in case someone needs to revert to dedicated capacity to avoid the CPU fallback issues.

Priya Nair: merging timeline: merge PR after CI fixes (few long lines), followups by EOD. last call for any other blockers?

Sam Wei: none from infra. go ahead once CI is green. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: PR 4321 merged by Priya Nair at 2376543248
